items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Dick Boom(?). Well, he didn't like me... He didn't like me, because if he had an attraction to book in this territory, my territory, he couldn't get through. Because see, I booked...

ctx.x: I know there was a guy that used to live in your(?) neighborhood that you were connected with...
What happened with you and him, and what was that about? Where did that come out?
